items.title: Jane Monheit interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, August 20, 2010
items.q: I mean they might say well Joe Williams that night looked marvelous in his tux.

ctx.x: Generally they have more to say about my looks than they do about my music, which drives me nuts. And it goes in both directions. You know I’ll have reviews that — I was talking about this in an interview just yesterday. I’ll have reviews that focus on how hideous I looked than I sounded; and reviews that focused more on how great I looked than how I sounded. And I disagree with them. I tend to agree with the hideous-sayers. But yeah, it’s ridiculous. I mean what, just because I’m a young woman like that you’ve…
You know they don’t do that with men singers. They don’t comment. I mean they might say well Joe Williams that night looked marvelous in his tux. But then that’s pretty much it.

Yeah. And instrumentalists never. And I enjoy the dressing up and the glamour and all of that. It’s super fun, I mean I love it, it’s really fun. But at a certain point though it’s like come on, really? This is what you’re going to talk about?
